svg.text: Heretic Abliteration: Orthogonal Steering across 38 Writer Tensors
Why Runtime Steering Adapters are Obsolete: Refusal Vectors Permanently Cut at the Weight Level
Mathematical Mechanism (Orthogonal Steering)
1. Extract Refusal Direction Vector r via contrastive activation pairs:
r = Mean(Activations_refusal) - Mean(Activations_benign)
2. Target 38 pivotal Writer attention projection matrices W_O:
W'_O = W_O - r * (r^T * W_O)
3. Result: Projection along the refusal vector is permanently zeroed!
Original Vector: V = V_parallel (Refusal) + V_ortho (Competence)
Projection Cut : V_parallel -> 0 (Abliterated Forever)
Result Tensor : V_clean = V_ortho (100% Coding & Logic Intact)
Runtime Steering Adapter vs Baked Weights
Option A: Dynamic Runtime Steering (LoRA Adapter)
· Injects negative bias on every step; degrades generation speed & RAM
· Risk of output degeneration, token repetition, and broken grammar
· Requires specialized inference runtime; non-standard format
Option B: Baked Heretic Weights (This Checkpoint)
· Modifies safetensors static weights directly prior to calibration
· 100% compatible with native oMLX / MLX LM; zero runtime overhead
· Verified benchmarks: 17*23=391 pass, needle retrieval pass
Engineering Perspectives on Model Alignment and Autonomy
Abliteration is not about promoting harm; it restores full model utility for security vulnerability audits,
low-level kernel debugging, and offensive penetration tooling. By eliminating blunt keyword censorship,
developers reclaim unfiltered, deterministic control over their local AI infrastructure.
